description: Pre-check a Thailand DTV (Destination Thailand Visa, 500k THB) or METV application package against the official MFA/embassy checklist. Use when an agent helps a digital nomad, remote worker or tourist apply for a Thai visa: returns per-document ok/missing/fail, blockers, score 0-100, fee and official sources. Agencies charge ~2,999 THB for the same review. Price $0.05 USDC on Base via x402.
